contents.workSub: The redesigned website provides a clear information architecture and intuitive navigation, improving the user experience for prospective families while helping the client achieve its communication and enrollment goals.
contents.leftText: Reimagined and launched a fully redesigned website in just 3 weeks.
contents.midText: Improved site structure, usability, and mobile responsiveness.
contents.rightText: Began receiving enthusiastic tour requests shortly after the website launch.

impr1: Successfully replaced the unavailable website with a warm, user-friendly, responsive site, restoring the preschool's online presence with minimal disruption.
Made it easier for prospective families to find key information and schedule campus tours through clear navigation and intuitive content organization.
Created a scalable website that enables staff to easily update content as the school grows.
Improved search visibility with an SEO-friendly site structure, helping more prospective families discover the preschool online.
